channel.title: MCP :: Gonemaster
channel.description: gonemaster-mcp exposes gonemaster-server’s admin API to Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients as a set of tools. It speaks stdio MCP and forwards requests to the server over HTTP; it does not run the engine itself. Any MCP-compatible client or agent framework can drive it, for example Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Zed, or a custom agent built on an MCP SDK. The client launches the bridge as a subprocess and talks to it over stdin/stdout.
